title: Gūthakhādasuttaṃ
text: 213 . ‘‘Idhāhaṃ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ purisaṃ gūthakūpe nimuggaṃ ubhohi hatthehi gūthaṃ khādantaṃ…pe… eso, bhikkhave, satto imasmiṃyeva rājagahe duṭṭhabrāhmaṇo ahosi. So kassapassa sammāsambuddhassa pāvacane bhikkhusaṅghaṃ bhattena nimantetvā doṇiyo gūthassa pūrāpetvā etadavoca – aho bhonto, yāvadatthaṃ bhuñjantu ceva harantu cāti…pe…. Dutiyaṃ.
